mn24:2.1: para. 2. Jātibhūmaka—from the … native land. Not in P.T.S. Dict.
mn24:5.4: Meaning to stay in the attainments of meditation for the day.
mn24:9.11: para. 9. for ‘the path and what is not the path’ cf. Sutta 98, para. 7, v. 34.
mn24:17.13: Great being (as tusker elephant or serpent), here a synonym for Arahant.
